title: Problem Solving & the AMC 10
summary: Learn how the AMC 10 works and the habits that solve contest problems: read carefully, draw it, work backwards, test the choices, estimate, decide when to leave a blank and when to skip (the 2-minute rule).
bigIdeas: Read the question twice, then draw it.
A blank is worth 1.5 points; a wrong answer is worth 0.
